svg.title: Alex: Backend-first developer, Kyiv, Ukraine
svg.desc: Hyprland desktop on Arch Linux. A kitty terminal runs fastfetch: Backend-first developer in Kyiv, Ukraine, 3+ years of experience; backend .NET 10, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, MediatR; frontend React 19, Next.js, TypeScript, TanStack; mobile Expo, React Native. Side windows list current work and a one-year contribution graph: 3349 contributions, 35-day streak.
